title: How to watch I Am Helen online for FREE — stream latest installment of powerful anthology series from anywhere
excerpt: New installment in ground-breaking franchise stars Nicola McCoughlin as a woman trapped in a coercive and suffocating relationship. Here's how to watch I Am Helen online from anywhere.
content_html:

Dominic Savage’s BAFTA winning anthology returns, with Nicola Coughlan taking on the lead in two-parter I Am Helen.

Coughlan plays the titular Helen, a woman who finds herself trapped as her once loving relationship turns toxic when her boyfriend Steve (Joe Cole), becomes slowly radicalised by the rhetoric of the ‘manosphere.’

Promising a story that “examines the pressures and expectations placed on women while confronting the realities of toxic masculinity and the damage it can create in modern relationships,” I Am Helen sees Steve absorbed by misogynistic online spaces, becoming coercive and putting pressure on Helen for marriage and children. Asserting her independence only causes Steve to spiral further, leaving Helen caught until some unexpected news changes everything…

Powerful, timely and necessary, the I Am… series is difficult, but gripping television, so read on and find out how to watch I Am Helen online and from anywhere.

Is I Am Helen part of a series?

A two-part miniseries in it's own right, I Am Helen is part of the larger I Am... anthology, telling female-led stories "authentically exploring the personal experiences of women through provocative, emotionally raw storytelling."

Debuting in 2019, the series is written and directed by filmmaker Dominic Savage in creative partnership with the lead actor, and has featured the likes of Kate Winslet, Vicky McClure, Letitia Wright, Suranne Jones and more, boasting multiple BAFTA award wins and nominations.
